_meta.description: Detection lists read from the card faces of B&B Shuffle scenario cards. Each scenario card prints a 'DETECTION' section naming the Procedure cards (and sometimes non-procedure notes) that detect that attack. Keyed as '<type>:<exact scenario card name>' -> [detection entries as printed]. build_card_details.py merges these into docs/card-details.json and canonicalizes each entry to the deck's real Procedure-card name when possible.
_meta.method: Card-face reading (image OCR / multimodal) of shared/decks/*/*.png; scenario cards only.
_meta.coverage: deck=core (32 scenario cards) and deck=core-v1, which reprints the same card art. Listed in byDeck below.
notes: DETECTION text is printing-specific, so these lists apply ONLY to the decks named in byDeck. Example: 'Bring Your Own (Exploited) Device' prints 'Firewall Log Review / NetFlow, Zeek/Bro, RITA Analysis' on the Core and Core v1 cards, 'Firewall Log Review / Network Threat Hunting - Zeek/RITA Analysis' on the v2.2 card, and 'Firewall Log Analysis / Network Threat Hunting / Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Log Analysis' on the v3 and v3.1 cards. Decks that reprint the v3.1 master art resolve their lists from docs/detection/mega-v31.json instead; keeping this map global would let the older print shadow it by card name alone.

Detection lists are transcribed exactly as printed, including humorous/non-procedure entries (e.g. 'DLP (Ha! Ha! Kidding. DLP never works.)', 'Working with HR', 'Prayers to an Engaged and Merciful God'). Those will not resolve to a deck Procedure card and are reported under card-details.json detection.unresolvedProcedureMatches.

CORE DECK C2 IMAGE-PATH BUG: shared/decks/core/carddb.json maps the 6 C2 cards to wrong PNG files. Actual art per file is: exfil-2=DNS as C2, exfil-3=BITS, exfil-4=Gmail/Tumblr/Salesforce/Twitter as C2, exfil-5=Domain Fronting as C2, exfil-6=HTTP as Exfil, exfil-7=HTTPS as Exfil. Detection entries below are keyed to the card NAME (authoritative), not to the carddb image pointer - another reason they are scoped by deck rather than by image.
